regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 2 general header and products 3ab–3ar
regions.finding: Eighteen aryl/heteroaryl/alkenyl boronic-acid scope experiments were retained with each printed time and isolated yield. Footnote b doubles Pd/S-phos for 3ai and retains 6% recovery; footnote c sets 3al to 40 °C. Five superscript-a Gorlos-phos results are separate experiments with their own times/yields and K2CO3 participant.

Seven symmetric-carbonate variants were retained separately with their printed times/yields. The machine labels preserve methyl, n-hexyl, cyclopropyl, chloropropyl, cyanopropyl, TBS-protected hydroxyalkyl, or phenyl termini without asserting uncertain product SMILES.

One 1i/2a experiment gives regioisomers 3ia and 3ia' in 68% combined yield and 1:1.2 ratio. The products are one experiment, not duplicate records; reaction time and measurement basis for the ratio are not printed.
Three independent scale-ups were retained: 1a→3aa (5 mmol, 12 h, 1.1137 g, 79%), 1a→3ae under Gorlos-phos/K2CO3 conditions (5 mmol, 17 h, 1.1289 g, 80%), and 1g→3gb (3 mmol, 12 h, 1.2604 g, 92%).

Three separate arrows were retained: CSA/MeOH deprotection 3gb→4 (88%), AcOH/DCC/DMAP esterification 4→5 (67%), and NIS/H2O iodohydroxylation 3gb→6 (76%, Z/E 20:1). The esterification yield is not treated as an overall yield from 3gb.
